focus: all four dimensions in one pass over the nine named commits, the changelog section and the three unlisted files

findingDetails.title: The mint and the lookup command look for a Claude transcript in different places when CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is set
findingDetails.case: A sender started with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR set, then a claim in the same checkout: the section prints and its command answers session_not_found.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Confirmed by reading both resolvers (relaunch-core.cjs:687 and :914 against cli.ts:289 and claude.mjs:38); not run. Fail-closed, so P2; P1 if CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is a supported setup for the lookup.
affectedSurfaceHints: a claim test that redeems through the entry

findingDetails.title: A claim mints a locator for whatever session id the note names, without proving that session ran in the note folder
findingDetails.case: A note whose session_id is a session from another project on the same machine and whose cwd is the receiver checkout: the claim prints the section and the command reads that other project transcript.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Confirmed by reading the mint, the command and the reader. The reach needs a note writer who knows a random session UUID, so this is hardening.
affectedSurfaceHints: a check that the transcript project key matches the note folder
a claim test with a foreign session id

findingDetails.title: The locator prepare stores has no reader
findingDetails.case: Any prepare by a Claude or Codex sender: the stored locator is replaced at claim and never read in between.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Inferred from the two callers and the claim path; a search for any other reader of a handover locator would confirm it.

findingDetails.title: The lookup stops working 30 minutes after the claim with no way to renew it, and the changelog and the receiver step do not say so
findingDetails.case: A receiver that works for 45 minutes and then needs a detail the note left out: the printed command answers locator_stale and nothing mints a new one.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Confirmed by reading the freshness check (cli.ts:37, :216), the claim guard (relaunch-core.cjs:1644) and both documents.
affectedSurfaceHints: the sentence the claim prints after the section
a renewal path for a claimed note

findingDetails.title: The entry reports a broken build as a bad operation
findingDetails.case: dist/hooks/lib/history/cli.js exists but one of its imports is missing after a partial build: the model is told its arguments are wrong and retries.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Confirmed by reading the entry and the offer guard (lookup-offer.ts:97-101); not run against a broken build.
affectedSurfaceHints: the refusal code list in cli.ts

results.notes: phase map matches the code; the phase 003 purpose and the phase 004 code disagree on who reads the prepare locator (R1-P2-003)
3 of 3 claim matches the summaries and run folders; test counts not rerun
Codex senders covered by unit tests only
catalog pages read at stat level only
playbook pages read at stat level only

noveltyJustification: First and only iteration: all five findings are new, weighted 5 of 5.
ruledOut: test helper mirroring the state path scheme
turn ids lost by the reader merge
